blocks.text: Memo: stop lifting fs01 into a Windows VM in Azure

This is the working cut for WTS-4471 on March 28, 2023. Brett Holtz asked for a written bound after the current path (\\fs01\dept, \\fs01\shared, \\fs01\scans, DFS namespace \\whetstone.internal\files) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, IT Support Intern, writing for Brett Holtz, Carla Nguyen, and Owen Briggs. Primary host fs01.whetstone.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on lift fs01 to a D8s v5 VM, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Move dept, shared, and scans to Azure Files. Leave CNC programs on fs01 until Owen signs a latency test. Reject the IaaS Windows file server quote ($22.6k year-1). I am not restating a hallway yes. lift fs01 to a D8s v5 VM is out because Quote kept SMB1 for the 2009 scanner. Azure Files with a private endpoint does not. The scanner path is a leftover, not a reason to buy a VM. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at shares=3, year1=22.6, smb=1.0, tb=4.8, latency=12.4, users=208, scanners=2, weeks=5. Sibling tickets WTS-MEM-2023-014 and WTS-4471-NET. I will not reopen lift fs01 to a D8s v5 VM in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Carla Nguyen is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
